title: Wiring a three-input AND gate
description: You can follow an internal signal through two component instances.

steps.description: and3 declares three inputs and one output. You also declare the and2 component and an internal signal named sig.
A1 connects inputs a and b to sig. A2 connects c and sig to the output z.

steps.question: Which instance consumes the result produced by A1?
steps.answer: A2 consumes sig as its b input and combines it with c.

steps.description: The second entity defines and2 with the expression a and b. You see successful analysis of both entities, while the supplied output states that no testbench is present for simulation.
